reported.quote: Consolidated operating revenues for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, was INR10,678 crores against INR10,461 crores in the same period last year
consolidated operating EBITDA for the quarter was INR421 crores against INR398 crores in the same period last year.
Consolidated operating PAT for the quarter was INR214 crores against INR217 crores in the same period last year.
Our working capital cycle remains at negative 7 days, complemented by a strong balance sheet, reflecting a net debt position of INR246 crores.
We maintain our return ratios with ROCE at 45.1% and ROE at 32% as on December 31, 2025, demonstrating the fundamental strength and stability.
